summary: Iteration 130 - Restaurant Table System Upgrades Testing Complete. All 18 backend API tests PASSED. Frontend UI verified: Admin Tables page (/admin/tables) with hardware mapping section, printer config save, floorplan drag/drop canvas, NFC write buttons. Public Guest page (/table/:tableId) with direct pay button generating QR/payment link. Staff Dashboard (/staff/dashboard) with hardware health and low-stock sections.

minor.issue: Returns 500 when USB printer device path doesn't exist in preview environment - acceptable behavior with file fallback

issues: Error banner 'Fehler' appears at top due to 401 errors on some background API calls - does not block functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Hardware mapping endpoints (/api/table-hardware, /api/table-hardware/printers) work correctly with role-based printer config
Table x/y position persistence works via PUT /api/tables/:id for floorplan drag/drop
Public bill-link endpoint /api/tables/:id/bill-link/public works without auth for guest direct payment
Low-stock endpoint /api/pos/stock/low integrates with restaurant system
Hardware health endpoint /api/pos/hardware/health shows printer status
NFC write button present on all table cards (Web NFC depends on browser/device support)
Printer slip generation uses file fallback when no hardware printer configured (acceptable for preview)
seed_data_creation: Test table 'Test Tisch 130' with BTN-130-UI created during UI testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 130 Restaurant Table System Upgrades verified. Key features tested: A) Hardware mapping - printer config save/list works via /api/table-hardware/printers, B) Direct payment - public bill-link endpoint generates QR code with invoice pay link, C) Floorplan - x/y position persistence works via PUT /api/tables/:id, D) Inventory integration - low-stock endpoint works, staff dashboard shows hardware health and low-stock sections. NFC write button is present but depends on Web NFC browser support. Printer hardware uses file fallback in preview environment.

hardware_mapping.details: GET /api/table-hardware returns printers list, POST /api/table-hardware/printers saves printer config by role (kitchen/service/bill)

floorplan_xy_persistence.details: PUT /api/tables/:id with x/y coordinates persists position for drag/drop floorplan

public_direct_pay.details: POST /api/tables/:id/bill-link/public generates payment QR code without auth, reuses existing invoice if available

low_stock_integration.details: GET /api/pos/stock/low returns products below minimum_stock threshold

nfc_write_button.details: NFC schreiben button present on all table cards, uses Web NFC API (browser dependent)

staff_dashboard_sections.details: Staff dashboard shows Warenwirtschaft/Low Stock and Hardware Health sections

mocked_apis.note: Printer hardware uses file fallback when no mapped hardware endpoint/device is available in preview
